g.text: Robin Fixed Comparison: Accuracy by Period
Combined scores pool channel error sums / observed counts before channel and seed means.
Both periods and every planned method are shown. Points are descriptive, not confidence intervals.
A mean of seed losses is not a prediction ensemble; the two periods are one site.
